Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Jeff Moss <detroitsportsrag@gmail.com>
Sent: Thursday, November 27, 2014 3:11 PM
To: Myers, Gene <gmyers@freepress.com>
Cc: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Anthony Fenech Inquiry 
 
Mr. Myers,
I am contacting you to find out why you chose Anthony Fenech over George Sipple when replacing John Lowe on the Tigers beat?
My sources have told me that Mr. Fenech has at least one DUI conviction. I am told there was another incident that I am still trying to dig up.
My sources also tell me that Mr. Fenech doesn't have a college degree. Is that a perquisite for a beat writers job at your paper?
It would seem that Mr. Fenech leap frogged Mr. Sipple for this promotion. Please advise why this decision was made.
